engines.label: Automatic by language
engines.notes: Mandarin uses Matcha Baker; Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, and French use the same Supertonic 3 graphs at five steps; other languages use offline eSpeak.

engines.label: Offline eSpeak NG (control)
engines.notes: Offline and instant, but measured at 55% CER in Mandarin and 62% WER in Russian. Retained as the control.

engines.label: Matcha ZH (baker)
engines.notes: Host winner on every measured gate. Corpus is non-commercial only.

engines.label: Supertonic 3 EN — 5 steps
engines.notes: host: Lane D D1 point estimate -8.9 pp WER; D3 6/6 short-input safe. Phone timing required.

engines.label: Supertonic 3 RU — 5 steps
engines.notes: host: first chunk 0.529 s P95, WER 1.7% — recommended

engines.label: Supertonic 3 ES — 5 steps
engines.notes: host: Lane D D3 6/6 short-input safe; Lane F F3 re-verified against PcmGate. Not phone-timed.
